## AI disclosure

<!--
Check the one level that best describes this pull request, including its code,
tests, documentation, and description. For levels 2-5, fill in the details below.
-->

- [ ] 0 — No AI tools were used or consulted.
- [ ] 1 — AI was used only for lookups, explanations, or advice; it wrote no code or text in this pull request.
- [ ] 2 — AI made small edits, which I reviewed.
- [ ] 3 — AI drafted substantial parts, which I reviewed.
- [ ] 4 — AI produced most or all of the content, which I reviewed thoroughly.
- [ ] 5 — AI produced the content with minimal human review.

Tools and models used:
How AI was used, and on which parts:

## License

<!--
Macaulay2 is free software, and we need to know that your contribution can be
shared under compatible terms. Most of Macaulay2, including most packages, is
licensed under the GNU General Public License, version 2 or later ("GPL-2+").
If you are not sure, checking the first two boxes is usually right.

If you copied or adapted anything from elsewhere (another program, a paper's
code, a website, etc.), give its source and license under "Details". If you
are unsure whether something is allowed, just say so and we will help.

Background reading:
- https://choosealicense.com/licenses/gpl-2.0/ (a plain-language summary)
- https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-faq.html (frequently asked questions)
- https://www.gnu.org/licenses/license-list.html (which licenses are GPL-compatible)

Check all that apply.
-->

- [ ] My changes use the existing license of the affected files or package.
